waha_servers_base_url_check.name: waha_servers_base_url_check
waha_servers_base_url_check.value: "waha_servers"."base_url" ~ '^https://[a-z0-9.-]+(:[1-9][0-9]{0,4})?(/[!-~]*)?$' AND "waha_servers"."base_url_host" = substring("waha_servers"."base_url" from '^https://([^/]+)') AND "waha_servers"."base_url_host" !~ ':443$' AND coalesce(substring("waha_servers"."base_url_host" from ':([0-9]+)$')::integer, 443) <= 65535

midtrans_attempts_gateway_check.name: midtrans_attempts_gateway_check
midtrans_attempts_gateway_check.value: ("midtrans_attempts"."gateway_status" IS NULL) = ("midtrans_attempts"."gateway_checked_at" IS NULL) AND char_length("midtrans_attempts"."gateway_status") <= 64 AND char_length("midtrans_attempts"."gateway_fraud_status") <= 64

orders_buyer_phone_present_check.name: orders_buyer_phone_present_check
orders_buyer_phone_present_check.value: "orders"."buyer_phone" IS NOT NULL OR "orders"."anonymized_at" IS NOT NULL

orders_anonymized_check.name: orders_anonymized_check
orders_anonymized_check.value:
"orders"."anonymized_at" IS NULL OR ("orders"."buyer_phone" IS NULL AND "orders"."buyer_name" = '' AND "orders"."buyer_email" = '' AND "orders"."ip" IS NULL AND "orders"."ua_hash" IS NULL
          AND "orders"."fbclid" IS NULL AND "orders"."fbp" IS NULL AND "orders"."fbc" IS NULL AND "orders"."ttclid" IS NULL AND "orders"."gclid" IS NULL)

app_settings_positive_int_check.name: app_settings_positive_int_check
app_settings_positive_int_check.value: ("app_settings"."key" NOT LIKE 'otp.%' AND "app_settings"."key" NOT LIKE 'orders.%' AND "app_settings"."key" NOT LIKE 'checkout.%' AND "app_settings"."key" NOT LIKE 'captcha.%' AND "app_settings"."key" <> 'trivia.extension_max_minutes') OR (jsonb_typeof("app_settings"."value") = 'number' AND ("app_settings"."value" #>> '{}')::numeric > 0 AND ("app_settings"."value" #>> '{}')::numeric = trunc(("app_settings"."value" #>> '{}')::numeric))

app_settings_bounds_check.name: app_settings_bounds_check
app_settings_bounds_check.value: CASE WHEN "app_settings"."key" NOT IN ('otp.code_ttl_seconds', 'otp.max_attempts', 'otp.phone_cap', 'otp.phone_window_seconds', 'otp.ip_cap', 'otp.ip_window_seconds', 'otp.cooldown_seconds', 'otp.global_send_cap', 'orders.expiry_seconds', 'orders.sales_close_buffer_minutes', 'checkout.ip_cap', 'checkout.ip_window_seconds', 'checkout.phone_cap', 'checkout.phone_window_seconds', 'checkout.lp_cap', 'checkout.lp_window_seconds', 'captcha.ip_cap', 'captcha.ip_window_seconds', 'captcha.ip48_cap', 'trivia.extension_max_minutes', 'delivery.wa_delay_seconds') THEN true WHEN jsonb_typeof("app_settings"."value") <> 'number' THEN false ELSE CASE "app_settings"."key" WHEN 'otp.code_ttl_seconds' THEN (value #>> '{}')::numeric BETWEEN 60 AND 900 WHEN 'otp.max_attempts' THEN (value #>> '{}')::numeric BETWEEN 1 AND 5 WHEN 'otp.phone_cap' THEN (value #>> '{}')::numeric BETWEEN 1 AND 10 WHEN 'otp.phone_window_seconds' THEN (value #>> '{}')::numeric BETWEEN 3600 AND 86400 WHEN 'otp.ip_cap' THEN (value #>> '{}')::numeric BETWEEN 1 AND 100 WHEN 'otp.ip_window_seconds' THEN (value #>> '{}')::numeric BETWEEN 600 AND 86400 WHEN 'otp.cooldown_seconds' THEN (value #>> '{}')::numeric BETWEEN 15 AND 600 WHEN 'otp.global_send_cap' THEN (value #>> '{}')::numeric BETWEEN 50 AND 100000 WHEN 'orders.expiry_seconds' THEN (value #>> '{}')::numeric BETWEEN 900 AND 86400 WHEN 'orders.sales_close_buffer_minutes' THEN (value #>> '{}')::numeric BETWEEN 5 AND 1440 WHEN 'checkout.ip_cap' THEN (value #>> '{}')::numeric BETWEEN 1 AND 1000 WHEN 'checkout.ip_window_seconds' THEN (value #>> '{}')::numeric BETWEEN 60 AND 86400 WHEN 'checkout.phone_cap' THEN (value #>> '{}')::numeric BETWEEN 1 AND 100 WHEN 'checkout.phone_window_seconds' THEN (value #>> '{}')::numeric BETWEEN 60 AND 86400 WHEN 'checkout.lp_cap' THEN (value #>> '{}')::numeric BETWEEN 1 AND 100000 WHEN 'checkout.lp_window_seconds' THEN (value #>> '{}')::numeric BETWEEN 60 AND 86400 WHEN 'captcha.ip_cap' THEN (value #>> '{}')::numeric BETWEEN 1 AND 1000 WHEN 'captcha.ip_window_seconds' THEN (value #>> '{}')::numeric BETWEEN 60 AND 86400 WHEN 'captcha.ip48_cap' THEN (value #>> '{}')::numeric BETWEEN 1 AND 100000 WHEN 'trivia.extension_max_minutes' THEN (value #>> '{}')::numeric BETWEEN 1 AND 1440 WHEN 'delivery.wa_delay_seconds' THEN (value #>> '{}')::numeric BETWEEN 0 AND 86400 END END

deletion_requests_state_check.name: deletion_requests_state_check
deletion_requests_state_check.value:
("deletion_requests"."status" = 'pending') = ("deletion_requests"."subject_phone" IS NOT NULL) AND ("deletion_requests"."status" = 'completed') = ("deletion_requests"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)
          AND ("deletion_requests"."status" = 'rejected') = ("deletion_requests"."rejected_at" IS NOT NULL AND "deletion_requests"."decision_note" IS NOT NULL)
          AND ("deletion_requests"."status" = 'pending') = ("deletion_requests"."decided_by_admin_user_id" IS NULL)

deletion_requests_note_check.name: deletion_requests_note_check
deletion_requests_note_check.value: "deletion_requests"."note" IS NULL OR char_length("deletion_requests"."note") BETWEEN 1 AND 500

settings_secrets_binding_check.name: settings_secrets_binding_check
settings_secrets_binding_check.value:
("settings_secrets"."scope" = 'conversions' AND "settings_secrets"."bound_host" IS NOT NULL AND ("settings_secrets"."adnet_id" IS NOT NULL
            OR ("settings_secrets"."name" ~ '^capi\.meta\.[0-9]{10,20}$' AND "settings_secrets"."bound_host" = 'graph.facebook.com')
            OR ("settings_secrets"."name" ~ '^capi\.tiktok\.[a-z0-9]{16,32}$' AND "settings_secrets"."bound_host" = 'business-api.tiktok.com')))
          OR ("settings_secrets"."scope" <> 'conversions' AND "settings_secrets"."adnet_id" IS NULL)

template_test_sends_target_check.name: template_test_sends_target_check
template_test_sends_target_check.value: ("template_test_sends"."channel" = 'whatsapp' AND "template_test_sends"."recipient" ~ '^\+[1-9][0-9]{7,14}$') OR ("template_test_sends"."channel" = 'email' AND "template_test_sends"."waha_session_id" IS NULL AND char_length("template_test_sends"."recipient") <= 254 AND "template_test_sends"."recipient" ~ '^[^@[:space:]]+@[^@[:space:]]+$')

upload_sessions_target_check.name: upload_sessions_target_check
upload_sessions_target_check.value: ("upload_sessions"."kind" = 'pdf' AND "upload_sessions"."product_id" IS NOT NULL AND "upload_sessions"."landing_page_id" IS NULL) OR ("upload_sessions"."kind" = 'lp_zip' AND "upload_sessions"."landing_page_id" IS NOT NULL AND "upload_sessions"."product_id" IS NULL)

attempt_questions_deadline_extension_che.name: attempt_questions_deadline_extension_check
attempt_questions_deadline_extension_che.value: "attempt_questions"."deadline_extension_ms" BETWEEN 0 AND 604800000 AND ("attempt_questions"."deadline_extension_ms" = 0 OR "attempt_questions"."deadline_at" - "attempt_questions"."served_at" >= "attempt_questions"."deadline_extension_ms" * interval '1 millisecond')

fulfillments_notes_check.name: fulfillments_notes_check
fulfillments_notes_check.value: "fulfillments"."notes" IS NULL OR char_length("fulfillments"."notes") BETWEEN 1 AND 2000

fulfillments_steps_check.name: fulfillments_steps_check
fulfillments_steps_check.value:
("fulfillments"."status" IN ('contacted', 'sent', 'done')) = ("fulfillments"."contacted_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("fulfillments"."contacted_at" IS NULL) = ("fulfillments"."contacted_by_admin_user_id" IS NULL)
          AND ("fulfillments"."status" IN ('sent', 'done')) = ("fulfillments"."sent_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("fulfillments"."sent_at" IS NULL) = ("fulfillments"."sent_by_admin_user_id" IS NULL)
          AND ("fulfillments"."status" = 'done') = ("fulfillments"."done_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("fulfillments"."done_at" IS NULL) = ("fulfillments"."done_by_admin_user_id" IS NULL)

winners_decision_reason_check.name: winners_decision_reason_check
winners_decision_reason_check.value: "winners"."decision_reason" IS NULL OR char_length("winners"."decision_reason") BETWEEN 10 AND 500

players_phone_present_check.name: players_phone_present_check
players_phone_present_check.value: "players"."phone" IS NOT NULL OR "players"."anonymized_at" IS NOT NULL

players_anonymized_check.name: players_anonymized_check
players_anonymized_check.value: "players"."anonymized_at" IS NULL OR ("players"."phone" IS NULL AND "players"."email" IS NULL AND "players"."auth_user_id" IS NULL AND "players"."name" = '')
